Q5910.reason: A recorded general-plan promise not to build, expressly binding successors who take with notice, is enforced in equity as an equitable servitude.

Q5623.reason: The commentary is opinion about a newsworthy public protest and a public figure, so the public-interest privilege defeats an invasion-of-privacy claim.

Q5004.reason: The shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach 25 can vest more than 21 years after lives in being, so it is void under the common-law RAP and the friend holds fee simple absolute.
